description: Use to list forms. Pass project_id for one website or client_id for one company (team is inferred). Otherwise Operator tokens (all workspaces) must pass team_id from list_teams. Team-scoped tokens may omit team_id and cannot target another workspace. Do not use to read resolved inheritance — call get_form.

client_id.description: Only forms under this client's projects.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's next_cursor.

status.description: Filter by archive state. Defaults to active.

team_id.description: Team id from list_teams. Required for operator tokens and OAuth logins; team-scoped frw_ tokens may omit it.

name: list_forms
title: List forms
